name: Rollups
description: Values derived from the instances that point at this one through a link of their schema's Links config: how many there are, how many hold each value of a field, the sum, least or greatest of a numeric field, and whether every one or some one is in a terminal state of its schema's Workflow, optionally one with a listed outcome. A value is computed when the instance is read, as the caller, from at most 500 linked instances; a rollup over more has none. A rollup of every or some one may gate states of the type's Workflow: a transition into one waits until the rollup holds.

field.description: For countBy, a string, enum or boolean field of the linked instances, or status when their schema composes Workflow; for sum, min and max, a numeric field.

function.description: count: how many instances point here. countBy: how many hold each value of field. sum, min, max: of the numeric field. all, any: whether every one, or some one, is in a terminal state of its schema's Workflow, with an outcome outcomes lists when it is given.

gatedStates.description: For all and any, the states of the type's Workflow that a transition into waits for the rollup to hold.

link.description: The link of that schema's Links config that points at this schema.

outcomes.description: For all and any, the outcomes a linked instance's terminal state must have to count; every outcome when absent.

schema.description: The schema whose instances point at this one; it composes Links.

rollups.description: The rollups, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

fields.name: rollups
fields.description: Each rollup's value, by name, computed when the instance is read: a count, counts by value, a number, or a boolean. A rollup whose link holds more than 500 instances is {"over": true} instead; a min or max with no value to compare is absent.

vetoes.description: A Workflow transition into a state an all or any rollup gates while the rollup does not hold, or has no value past 500 linked instances; details names the rollup and counts the linked instances.
